title: Permutation Sequence
key_insight: 用阶乘逐位确定排列中的数字
approach:
1. 计算阶乘
2. 逐位确定数字
3. 从候选中移除
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def getPermutation(self, n: int, k: int) -> str:
        from math import factorial
        nums=list(range(1,n+1))
        k-=1; res=''
        for i in range(n,0,-1):
            f=factorial(i-1)
            idx=k//f
            res+=str(nums[idx])
            nums.pop(idx)
            k%=f
        return res
